home.title: Fuelr
home.tagline: Save your recipes and plan your meals for the week.

next.title: Getting started
next.body: Edit app/[locale]/page.tsx, add your components under app/components/ui/, and declare every new route in i18n/routing.ts with its translated slug.

app.label: Your space
app.intro: Your recipes, your weekly plan and your shopping list live here. The screens are on their way — for now this page exists so we can check that access is properly guarded.

next.title: What comes next
next.body: The weekly plan, the recipe editor and the shopping list are separate backlog stories.

household.label: Household
household.title: My household
household.intro: One plan for everyone at home. Recipes stay with whoever wrote them, and each person keeps their own nutrition profile.

invitation.title: You have been invited to a household
invitation.body: Joining means seeing and editing the same week plan as the other members. Your recipes and your nutrition profile stay yours.

plan.title: Plan sharing
plan.openOwner: Your Family plan is active: you can invite up to five more people onto your week.
plan.openMember: You share this household's plan. The subscription belongs to whoever created it.
plan.closed: Sharing a plan is part of the Family plan. Without it your plan is still yours — nothing is taken away.
plan.notPurchasable: The Family plan cannot be subscribed to yet.
plan.cancelHint: Nothing is deleted: the household keeps its members and every plan stays readable.

confirm.title: Remove {name} from the household?
confirm.body: They keep their account and their recipes. They lose the shared plan and the Family subscription, and it takes a new invitation to bring them back.

invite.label: Invite by email
invite.hint: {seats, plural, =0 {The household is full.} one {# seat left.} other {# seats left.}}

leave.body: You will find your own plan exactly as you left it. The household plan is not touched.

shopping.empty: Nothing to buy: the week has no meals yet.

shopping.offlineHint: Copy saved on {date}. What you tick here will be sent when the network returns.

journal.label: Nutrition & tracking
journal.title: My diary
journal.intro: What you ate, written down without judgement. The diary is free; the target beside it and the findings below are part of the Plus plan.
journal.loggedDays: {logged, plural, =0 {no day written down} one {# day written down} other {# days written down}} of {days}

add.title: Write down a meal
add.body: A meal at a restaurant has no recipe and needs nobody to invent one. A name and a calorie count are enough.
add.name: Meal

NOTHING_LOGGED.finding: Nothing is written down this week.
NOTHING_LOGGED.action: Add a meal above, even a rough one: it is more use than an empty week.

PARTIAL_WEEK.action: The averages cover those days, not the whole week.

ENERGY_VS_TARGET.finding: {average} kcal on average per day written down, against a target of {target}.
ENERGY_VS_TARGET.action: A gap of {gap} kcal ({gapPercent}%). If it holds for weeks, it is the target that gets adjusted.

PROTEIN_BELOW_TARGET.finding: Protein: {average} g on average, against {target} g.
PROTEIN_BELOW_TARGET.action: A protein source at breakfast usually covers most of the missing {gap} g.

CONTAINS_ESTIMATES.finding: Some of this week's ingredients are estimated.
CONTAINS_ESTIMATES.action: The totals are orders of magnitude. Naming an ingredient more precisely is often enough for it to be recognised.

targets.title: My targets
targets.chosen: These are the figures you set.
targets.computed: These come from your profile. Until you set your own, they are suggestions.

locked.title: Targets, charts and findings
locked.body: The diary stays free and complete. What the Plus plan adds is the target beside the figures, the week's charts, and history further back than 30 days.
locked.order: You can switch to the Plus plan from your household.
locked.notPurchasable: The Plus plan cannot be subscribed to yet.

history.title: History
history.windowed: The free plan keeps a {days}-day window. Nothing is deleted: the rest comes back with the Plus plan.
